images.title: Four equal sides without a right angle
images.purpose: Shows rhombus ABCD with all sides 5 cm and ∠A = 50°, made by two compass arcs crossing at C.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One large rhombus in the centre, its equal sides marked, with two short construction arcs at the far corner.
images.exact_structure: One rhombus ABCD in dark outline: AB horizontal at the bottom, A bottom left and B bottom right; AD rises from A at 50° above AB, the same length as AB; D top left and C top right. All four sides carry one identical short teal (#0072B2) tick mark. A small reddish purple (#CC79A7) arc at A is labelled 50°. Two short thin grey (#6B7280) compass arcs, one centred on B and one centred on D, cross exactly at C. The label 5 cm sits under AB. The letters A, B, C, D sit outside their corners. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A quadrilateral with all sides equal is a rhombus, and it need not be a square.
images.description: Shows rhombus ABCD with all sides 5 cm and ∠A = 50°, made by two compass arcs crossing at C.
images.context: AB = AD = 5 cm, ∠A = 50°, arcs of radius 5 cm from B and D meet at C.

image_decisions.why: The equal tick marks with a clearly non right angle show that a rhombus is more than a square.
